title: Fixture design — Homelife

location.series: Cox Brand Collection — Lindsay Little / Periscope

slide_intent: Bring the service explanation beside a working demonstration so shoppers can connect the promise to an action.
strategic_value: The staffed Homelife counter can make a connected-home system feel approachable and tangible.
demonstration: A customer demonstration counter combines devices, a large overhead Homelife screen, line icons and a family photograph behind the staff.
practical_value: Place the category cue above the demonstration and keep the devices accessible at hand height.

content_islands.name: Category sign
content_islands.spec: Mount a screen with the Homelife name and house-shaped icon above the counter.

content_islands.name: Demonstration surface
content_islands.spec: Arrange the touchscreen and connected devices along the white counter beside the customers and staff.

content_islands.name: Supporting context
content_islands.spec: Keep a large family image behind the demonstration and a smaller bundle poster on the adjacent wall.
